# Consumable API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The shared catalogue of single-use products, such as probe designs, virus constructs and reagents.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/resources/consumable/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `consumable` (detail, create, update), `consumables` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Uniqueness:** `name`, `supplier` unique together
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [Consumable type](/api/schemas/consumable/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`consumablestock`](/api/modules/consumablestock/), [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/), [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/), [`materialusagetemplate`](/api/modules/materialusagetemplate/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `description` | string; max 2000 characters |
| `supplier` | [`supplier`](/api/resources/supplier/) id **[required]** |
| `type` | one of the [Consumable types](/api/schemas/consumable/) **[required]** |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `rrid` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Research Resource Identifier (RRID) for tracking standardized research resources |
| `rrid_url` | string **[read-only]** |
| `external_identifiers` | JSON object; nullable. External identifiers and their source URLs from various databases (NCBI, JAX, DOI, etc.) |
| `comments` | string |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('consumable', load_all=True)
records = resp['consumables']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('consumable', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.consumables;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "consumables": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Consumable 1",
            "description": "",
            "supplier": "<supplier-id>",
            "type": "ImmunoReagent",
            "details": {
                "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
            },
            "rrid": "",
            "rrid_url": "",
            "external_identifiers": {},
            "comments": "",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('consumable', data={"name": "Consumable 1", "supplier": "<supplier-id>", "type": "AdhesiveCement", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}})
record = resp.json()['consumable']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Consumable 1', 'supplier', '<supplier-id>', 'type', 'AdhesiveCement', 'details', struct()), 'consumable');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.consumable;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('consumable', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['consumable']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('consumable', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.consumable;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "consumable": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Consumable 1",
        "description": "",
        "supplier": "<supplier-id>",
        "type": "ImmunoReagent",
        "details": {
            "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
        },
        "rrid": "",
        "rrid_url": "",
        "external_identifiers": {},
        "comments": "",
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('consumable', id='<id>', data={"name": "Consumable 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Consumable 1 (renamed)'), 'consumable', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/resources/consumable/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('consumable', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'consumable');
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Consumable data model page](/datamodel/resources/consumable/).
